mapper.select: SELECT id, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, deleted, version, material_id AS materialId, user_id AS userId, target_word AS targetWord, probe_type AS probeType, question, options_json AS optionsJson, correct_answer AS correctAnswer, hint, generation_source AS generationSource, selected_answer AS selectedAnswer, is_correct AS isCorrect, score, illuminated, answered_time AS answeredTime FROM learning_rumination_probe WHERE id = #{probeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_rumination_probe SET selected_answer = #{selectedAnswer}, is_correct = #{isCorrect}, score = #{score}, illuminated = #{illuminated}, answered_time = #{answeredTime}, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = #{answeredTime} WHERE id = #{probeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND answered_time IS NULL
